messages:
Maya Patel: quick huddle 1: ACME pilot moved up. they need SSO for invite-only pilot. can we hit the milestone without shipping admin UI?
Ravi Singh: minimal SSO = auth + attribute mapping behind FF. admin UI can be v1.
Owen Park: engineering estimate: SAML handshake + KMS cert support = ~8 dev days, QA + e2e = 2 days. admin UI ~2w.
Lin Zhao: ops: cert rotation, KMS, and monitoring are mandatory. won't cut those.
Maya Patel: propose cutlist: defer analytics export, per-tenant quota UI, bulk migration tools. keep SAML stub + runbook.
Ravi Singh: I'll own the SAML stub. plan: IdP metadata parser, signed assertion check, attribute->user map only. FF: `feature.saml_pilot`.
Owen Park: CI: will add `ci/auth-smoke` job and e2e smoke post-deploy. release-bot: schedule deploy window?
release-bot: staging deploy scheduled: 1799999950. run auth smoke tests after deployment.
Maya Patel: decision: 1) freeze admin & analytics for MVP; 2) ship SAML stub behind FF; 3) run invite-only pilot on target date; 4) full admin flows in v1. I'll update roadmap and ping execs.
Owen Park: adding milestone tile now. :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: thanks team, closing thread. :thumbsup:
